flyers.title: Oman National Day Offers at HyperMax in Oman

flyers.title: Thanksgiving Treats Offers at LuLu in Oman
flyers.description: Shop the Thanksgiving Treats promotion at LuLu in Oman, valid until 30 November 2026. Find deals on meat, chicken, and seafood as well as groceries and fresh food. flyers.title: Shop & Win 10 Million Happiness Points at LuLu Oman
flyers.description: Join the LuLu Oman Shop & Win promotion through 17 December 2026 to win a share of 10 million Happiness Points. flyers.title: Super Friday Electronics and Appliance Deals at LuLu Oman
